# docker_compose_containers (Data Source)

Lists the containers of a compose project, like `docker compose ps`, by the `com.docker.compose.project` label (one-off `run` containers excluded). Works for projects created by `docker_compose` and by the compose CLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_containers" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
  all  = true
}

output "states" {
  value = { for c in data.docker_compose_containers.shop.containers : c.names[0] => c.state }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Include stopped containers (CLI `--all`). Default `false`: running containers only.
- `services` (List of String) Only these services (default: every service of the project).

### Read-Only

- `container_ids` (Map of List of String) Map of service name to the IDs of its selected containers, in container-number order.
- `containers` (Attributes List) The project's containers, ContainerSummary fields plus service/number from the compose labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))
- `containers_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON array of the project's ContainerSummary objects (GET /containers/json, project label filter). Sensitive: Command can carry interpolated secrets.
- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `containers_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
